title_en: Near the former Profarmes, fully invested 1+1 apartment for sale!!!
description_en: At Isht Profarma, Newly Invested 1+1 Apartment for Sale. The apartment is located on the 1st floor of a new 8-story building with an elevator. The apartment has an area of ​​46.5 m2 and is organized in a spacious living room with a kitchenette, 1 bedroom and a bathroom. The apartment is completely invested, starting from the electrical and plumbing installations, parquet, windows, external and internal doors, completely renovated toilet, also the external facade made of hoods. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the facilities for a comfortable life, taking into account schools, nurseries, hospitals, markets, etc., the apartment is also a very good opportunity to rent due to the high demand.
